    # RHS calculation: k(k-1) + sum_{i=k+1}^N min(k, d_i)
    rhs = k * (k - 1)
    sum_min = 0
    for i in range(k, N):
        sum_min += min(k, degrees[i])
    
    rhs += sum_min

        print(f"Failed at k={k}: LHS={sum_d_k}, RHS={rhs}")
        is_graphic = False
